name: TimeFormatter
src_typeComment: Static formatting helpers for turning a raw seconds value into common display strings — timers, cooldowns, playtime stats. Takes plain floats rather than TimeSpan so it drops straight into a Time.deltaTime-driven countdown without a TimeSpan conversion step.

src_members.name: ToCompact
src_members.comment: 4000 -> "1h 6m", 125 -> "2m 5s", 45 -> "45s" — compact, drops leading zero units instead of padding, for a HUD-friendly display rather than a fixed-width clock.
